subject: Commercial activation checklist: procurement route & billing start
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@brightarc.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial activation checklist: procurement route & billing start

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment on procurement + trial->paid timing.

High-level recap:
- Pilot scope: 3 internal apps, expected peak usage ~100k tokens/day (bursty), embeddings for search (~10k vectors/day).
- Primary procurement preference: looks like procurement prefers a PO for production, but card for initial pilot could be an option.
- Success criteria (from your team): sustained >=70% active users across pilot cohort, query latency <250ms p50, and usage >=50k tokens/day by week 4.

Action items I propose:
1) We’ll send a short trial plan + SOW draft for your legal/procurement review (attached).
2) Can you confirm whether procurement requires a vendor questionnaire (SOC2 / dataflow) before issuing PO? If so, share contact.
3) Please confirm your preferred billing start date assuming PO delivered on time — we can delay billing to the agreed start date.

Attachments included: Redwood-trial-plan.xlsx (detailed gates), SOW-draft.pdf (standard pilot SOW).

Next steps: If you can confirm procurement contact and timeline today/tomorrow, we’ll lock the trial start window and reserve dedicated pilot capacity.

Thanks — Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198

From: Alex Torres <atorres@brightarc.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jill Murray <jill.murray@brightarc.io>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 17:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial activation checklist: procurement route & billing start

Thanks Rachel — good recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Procurement: we do prefer issuing a PO for production / post-pilot, but Procurement is usually OK with a company card for a short pilot (<30 days) if Engineering owns the card. For legal/controls they will want a vendor security questionnaire (we typically request SOC2 Type II evidence).
- Contacts: Jill Murray (cc'd) will own procurement and legal intake. Jill — can you confirm turnaround on vendor questionnaire review and PO issuance?
- Success criteria: your restatement looks right. One add — we’d like to see false-positive rate on reranking <5% for our primary flows.

Tentative timeline:
- Questionnaire out this week, review complete by April 1 (Jill to confirm).
- If all good, PO issuance target week of April 4–8.

Marketplace: we discussed the marketplace option briefly — BrightArc is interested in a marketplace listing for easier renewals but it’s not blocking the PO.

Appreciate you sending the SOW + trial plan. I’ll route those to Jill and Procurement.

Best,
Alex
Head of Product, BrightArc
atorres@brightarc.io

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Torres <atorres@brightarc.io>
Cc: Jill Murray <jill.murray@brightarc.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commercial activation checklist: procurement route & billing start

Alex / Jill — quick follow-up with concrete asks so we can lock dates: 

1) Procurement path decision: please confirm by end of week (3/26) whether you’ll issue a PO for pilot start or use card billing. If PO, please provide expected PO issuance date.
2) Vendor questionnaire: if Procurement requires SOC2 evidence, we can share our security pack and SOC2 attestation; what is your intake process (doc tracker / portal)?
3) Billing start: assuming PO is issued week of 4/4, do you want billing to begin on PO acceptance or on the pilot launch date? We can accommodate either — please pick (A) billing on PO acceptance or (B) billing on pilot launch (we’ll set an agreed start date).
4) Trial success gates: we’ll run the trial for 30 days with weekly check-ins. Please confirm the primary metric we should track (usage tokens/day vs adoption % vs latency).

Suggested target dates (so procurement has something concrete):
- Questionnaire submission: 3/24
- PO issuance: 4/06 (if on schedule)
- Pilot launch & billing start: 4/07 (if billing on pilot launch)

If you prefer billing to start only after receipt of PO, we can set billing start to 4/06. Please confirm which option you prefer so we can update the SOW and billing config.

Action items for BrightArc: confirmation of (PO vs card), procurement contact intake link, and primary success metric.

Thanks — Rachel

Rachel / Alex — quick note from Procurement: we’ll run the vendor security questionnaire this week. Expect a short list of follow-ups; SOC2 Type II evidence is required for PO issuance. PO timeline: we can turn around a standard PO by 4/05 if we receive the SOW + vendor security pack by 3/24.

For billing start, BrightArc prefers billing to start on pilot launch (Option B) to align internal cost tracking. If Redwood can set billing start to the agreed pilot launch date, that works for us.

I’ll attach our PO template once Procurement finalizes it (cc'd).

Thanks,
Jill Murray
Senior Procurement Manager | BrightArc Inc.
procure@brightarc.io
